summary: Revision 1 correctly scopes the authorized follow-up to additive construction of all three DRAFT candidate systems in the exact existing Figma file. It preserves legacy assets and access settings, registers the three source documents, and holds mutation until independent design-spec approval and preview completion. A single writer, sequential retry-safe batches, immediate ID recording, explicit inventory, actual bindings and modes, structural readbacks and independent rendered review provide a feasible completion boundary.
